title: VIXEN preset and build-tree working-directory contract is ambiguous
body: The queued cmake --preset vixen-wsl-debug failed from the VIXEN worktree root because CMakePresets.json lives in VIXEN; after configuring from VIXEN, cmake --build build/wsl-debug failed from VIXEN because the generated build tree is at the worktree root. Workaround: configure from VIXEN, then build from the worktree root. The facade/tooling should expose one documented working-directory-safe entry point.

title: VIXEN CTest discovery omits the configured gtest targets
body: The queued ctest --test-dir build/wsl-debug -R 'test_gpu_chunk_cost_cacher|test_rendergraph_dispatch' --output-on-failure exited 0 with 'No tests were found' after configuration. The valid queued workaround was invoking the built gtest executables directly with filters. The test registration facade should make configured vixen_gtest_discover_tests targets visible to CTest.
